text:
Maria (Partnerships): Quick sync — we need to finalize the LangChain/LlamaIndex gateway adapter joint announcement + marketplace listing. Can folks confirm readiness and blockers? :eyes:
Jon (Eng Integrations): Working on the adapter QA. Main blocker is the sample app auth flow — we need a short-lived token example for marketplace smoke tests.
Sophie (Product): We have the feature doc ready, will drop a minimal "sample flows" section today. Can someone pair on the auth snippet?
Kevin (Marketing): Tentative announcement week is W+2. We need a one-liner, hero screenshot, and marketplace copy by EOD Friday to hit that.
Elena (Legal): Heads-up: partner review needed for the joint messaging. Send me the draft copy and any partner trademarks.
Jon (Eng Integrations): I'll attach an auth example. For now, use this snippet in docs:
```
POST /v1/connectors/oauth/token
body: {"grant_type":"client_credentials", "scope":"gateway.read"}
```
Maria (Partnerships): Nice. Sophie, can product own the sample app walkthrough? It'll live in the marketplace "examples" tab.
Sophie (Product): Yep, will own it. Jon — can you add a short README that shows "local dev -> deploy to marketplace" steps? Keep it < 5 mins to run.
Jon (Eng Integrations): Yep — plan: 1) small Dockerfile, 2) env var auth snippet, 3) smoke test script `scripts/smoke.sh`.
Kevin (Marketing): Also need a customer-facing launcher GIF for the marketplace tile. Can we get a 10s clip of the sample app in action?
Jon (Eng Integrations): I'll capture it after smoke tests pass.
Elena (Legal): Also confirm logs & telemetry in sample app don't contain PII. Add a note in README about anonymized logs.
Maria (Partnerships): Good call. Action items: Jon = sample app + smoke tests + GIF, Sophie = sample walkthrough + README, Kevin = draft announcement + screenshot, Elena = partner signoff. I'll coordinate partner comms and timeline.
Kevin (Marketing): Draft headline idea: "Redwood + LangChain: Fast gateway integration for production inference" — will iterate. :tada:
deploy-bot: release-checklist queued for `adapter-sample-app` — status: pending smoke tests.
Jon (Eng Integrations): ETA for smoke pass: tomorrow morning PDT. If anything blocks, I'll ping in #eng-oncall.
Sophie (Product): I'll have marketplace copy by EOD Friday for review.
Maria (Partnerships): Great. If anyone ramps into blockers, drop ✅ or a quick note here. Otherwise I'll prep partner timeline doc and share link once ready.
Kevin (Marketing): ✅
Elena (Legal): ✅ — will review copy within 24h once shared.
Jon (Eng Integrations): 👍 will ping after smoke pass.
